name: Ebrotidine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Peru and Spain, first in 1998 — for liver harm

summary: Ebrotidine was taken off the market in Spain and Peru starting in 1998 because it caused harm to the liver [3]. In tests from a small computer model rather than studies in people, the drug received a high risk score of 82 for the liver [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low risk score of 36 for the heart instead of evaluating real patients [M].
